misconceptions.description: Saving every coursework file loose on the Desktop or in Downloads instead of a course folder tree
misconceptions.trigger: learner stores files like Final2_real.docx next to unrelated downloads with no folder per course
misconceptions.feedback: Build a folder tree: CAT100 / Module07 / assignment, then save into it. A flat Desktop hides which file belongs to which task.

misconceptions.description: Naming files final.docx, document(1).docx, or untitled so versions cannot be told apart
misconceptions.trigger: learner has Essay_final.docx, Essay_final2.docx, and Essay_FINAL_real.docx in one folder
misconceptions.feedback: Use a name pattern like 2026-05-28_cat100_essay_v3.docx so date, course, task, and version are all readable at a glance.

misconceptions.description: Keeping the only copy of coursework on one local drive with no cloud or external backup
misconceptions.trigger: learner edits directly on a USB stick or local folder with no synced copy
misconceptions.feedback: Keep at least two copies in two places (for example local plus OneDrive). One drive failure should not erase a submission.

misconceptions.description: Grouping by file extension (all PDFs together, all images together) instead of by course and task
misconceptions.trigger: learner has one Images folder mixing photos from every class
misconceptions.feedback: Organize by course then task so related files travel together. Type-based folders scatter one assignment across many places.

misconceptions.description: Trusting an AI bulk-rename or organize-my-folder action across a whole folder without checking which file is the real latest version
misconceptions.trigger: learner accepts every AI rename and auto-delete suggestion in one click, including removal of files the tool labels duplicates
misconceptions.feedback: Treat AI organize suggestions as a bounded move: accept what fits your naming convention, modify what is close, and reject anything you cannot verify, especially deletions, because the tool cannot know which version holds your corrected work.
